authority: Hand-authored audit judgements. Mechanical facts are DERIVED, not stored: nav placement, palette/drawer/tab/quick-action presence and capability come from frontend/lib/nav-model.js; access class from frontend/lib/public-routes.js. frontend/__tests__/route-inventory.test.js fails if a page route is missing here, if an access class disagrees with public-routes, or if a contextualFrom file does not actually link the route.

accessClasses.self_authed: isSelfAuthedPagePath: the page runs its own (auction) sign-in
accessClasses.unlisted: isUnlistedPagePath: reachable by exact link only, linked from nowhere
accessClasses.redirect: legacy path whose page only redirects
accessClasses.dev: developer reference, linked from no navigation

statuses.working: live and offered in nav or contextually
statuses.share_target: live; entered from share links / sitemap / OG cards, its content also renders inline in the app
statuses.disabled_by_flag: page exists, its flag/capability is off, so it is not offered
statuses.intentionally_hidden: live but deliberately absent from nav (owner-gated or token-link entry)
